description: A staged pipeline for async work in the browser and Node: per-stage concurrency, batching, pause and cancel, live progress.
rules: Every item needs a unique string id. push() throws for an item without one and ignores an id that is already queued or running.
Return an object from run() to merge its fields into the item, or return nothing. Returning a string, an array or a number fails the item.
A batch stage uses batch plus runBatch(items, ctx). Return one patch per item in the same order, or nothing.
Pass ctx.signal to fetch and workers so cancel() stops work in flight. Cancelled runs keep their concurrency slot until they settle.
Use barrier: true on a stage that must wait until every item has finished the earlier stages.
Subscribe with on(event, listener) and keep the returned function to unsubscribe. There is no off().
Failed items are not retried. Push a failed item again to re-run it from the start, or with { startAt } to enter at a later stage.
Throttle 'progress' listeners with requestAnimationFrame before painting. progress() is always current.
pipelino is ESM only. TypeScript projects need the DOM lib or @types/node for the AbortSignal type.
